integrity: The all-parameter proof uses conditional binomial parity, strict Jensen convexity, and a unimodal first difference. Finite exact-arithmetic checks independently enumerate small allocations and test sign patterns; they do not replace the proof. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform allocation, at least three boxes, fixed integer sample length. No result for nonuniform box weights, random sample size, or higher-order dependence. A zero covariance at the possible unique odd-frequency transition is not arithmetically ruled out; no finite-size error bound is claimed for the asymptotic cutoff. Classical multinomial moment formulas may implicitly yield the raw covariance; historical priority of the sign classification is qualified.
title: Parity-selective covariance transitions in uniform occupancy and hypercube walks
